title: Rafael and the Choir
author: Ivo Quintana
blurb: Ansel Nakamura, a beast-speaker hiding a forbidden gift, has never left the valley where magic cannot follow. Then the old gods begin answering prayers again — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must carry a secret that could reignite an ancient war before the usurper's armies reach the free cities.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
